how_to_pin: On a machine with legitimate access, download both files from the URLs above.
cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.phase4a authenticate --kind disease --csv parkinsons.data   (must exit 0)
cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.phase4a authenticate --kind risk --csv parkinsons_updrs.data (must exit 0)
